description: Fahrradstadtplan Krefeld is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Krefeld. The cycling city map Krefeld contains information for cyclists in Krefeld and neighboring places. It shows on the basis of the city map Krefeld - cycle paths, - the cycling hub network, regional themed routes, circular hiking trails, the Krefeld cycling axes and the cycling network North Rhine-Westphalia, - cycle lanes, 30-speed zones and traffic-calmed ... Coverage: Stadt Krefeld. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle city map Krefeld" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Krefeld. Its keywords include E-Bike, viel Verkehr, Fahrradspur, Stadtbahn, Pfahl, Hindernis. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
